rules.rule: Read source records read-only and preserve original bytes and SHA-256.
Build deterministic source_record_key from project_id, record_type, and source primary key.
Do not infer missing field meanings without explicit rule or human approval.
Unresolved mappings, collisions, or unrecoverable event ordering block commit.
Generate targets only in staging; validate schema and semantic rules before commit.
Repeated migration of the same source snapshot and rule version must yield identical target SHA-256 values computed over RFC 8785 JCS canonical UTF-8 bytes.
Rollback restores the active dataset pointer; it never deletes source history.

If a source record has any unresolved mapping, quarantined unknown field, or unapproved normative artifact transformation, do not emit a target record or target_sha256; report any provisional candidate digest under a candidate-prefixed field only.
Before migration, verify the exact candidate bundle manifest, all expected record types, each schema path, and every schema SHA-256 against the manifest.
Inventory JSON/YAML/YML source files; reject duplicate mapping keys, non-JSON YAML values, unsupported YAML aliases, malformed inputs, and source symlinks rather than silently skipping them.

Emit a complete ID-mapping provenance row with source-relative URI, hashes, rule identifiers, review state, collision status, rewritten-reference count, UTC timestamp, and operator field; omitted operator is not approval.

validation_ids_resolution.rule: Resolve only a unique primary key within the same project. A validation_activity reference additionally requires a valid timezone-aware ISO date-time started_at and an execution_status with an explicit mapping to a v1.4 target enum value. The current candidate does not infer that in_progress means running.
unresolved_cases: source execution_status without an explicit target-enum mapping
malformed JSON or non-object source file
artifact alternative_identity null-insertion rule pending normative approval
hashless artifact integrity downgrade rule pending normative approval

staging_output_policy: Staging output must be outside the input tree and use a new empty directory. The tool refuses non-empty output directories to prevent stale artifacts from being mistaken for current output. Every provisional target must pass full Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema validation with a format checker; any schema-invalid or otherwise unresolved target is withheld from staging.
source_record_uri_semantics: source_record_uri is a percent-encoded, input-relative URI reference; it is not a machine-specific absolute file URI.

id_mapping_policy.target_record_policy: A source record with any unresolved item does not receive a target_record or target_sha256 and is never written to staging. Provisional target identity/digest fields, when present, are explicitly prefixed candidate_target_.
id_mapping_policy.mapping_rule_id: MIG-002 identifies the source-record key mapping rule; applied_field_mapping_ids list record-type-specific field mappings used by the candidate transformation.
id_mapping_policy.operator_policy: operator is recorded as not_recorded when omitted; this is not an approval identity and cannot authorize commit.
id_mapping_policy.collision_check_policy: failed for duplicate same-project/same-record-type primary keys; passed_typed_primary_key only when a typed key is present and no duplicate was found; not_checked_missing_identity otherwise.

source_parser_policy.json: UTF-8 JSON; duplicate object keys and non-finite numeric constants are rejected.
source_parser_policy.yaml: UTF-8 YAML parsed with SafeLoader semantics; duplicate mapping keys, aliases, non-string mapping keys, non-JSON values, and non-finite numbers are rejected. PyYAML must be available or the source file is reported unresolved.
source_parser_policy.unsupported_formats: Unsupported file extensions are not treated as source records. Only JSON/YAML/YML files are inventoried by this prototype.

pending_normative_rules: Adding alternative_identity=null to a source Artifact remains unresolved until the relevant normative decision is explicitly approved.
Downgrading hashless external Artifact integrity_status from passed to needs_review remains unresolved until the relevant normative decision is explicitly approved.
target_digest_policy: SHA-256 over RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme canonical UTF-8 bytes of the transformed target record. This does not replace source_sha256, which hashes the original source bytes.
